title: Wait it's not just me??
content: This is wild. Reddit recommended this sub to me and I've only once or twice mentioned mall world out loud so idk where that came from. I thought this was just me. This has been going on for years. It's not just a mall but it started that way. Then an amusement park, zoo, and international airport got added. Then a beautiful beach town with adorable storefronts. Suburban homes nearby, including some I've been in more than once. Some things are ALMOST related to my real life, but not quite. There is an ice cream shop that in the dream I have been to with my grandma, but IRL we have no such place. Oh there's also this weird secret elevator in the mall that I discovered and it takes us to the underground (I seen others mention it) and weird back areas, all that I know I'm not supposed to be in and leave me very uneasy. I think my biggest question is, is this anyone else's SECOND mall world? I had a different one before. It wasn't as detailed. Much smaller mall, smaller underground, one main road into a small town or brick buildings with some kind of courthouse building at the end. Idk what happened, it's like I scrapped it and started a new one. My ONLY theory is that it happened when my mom died. It'll be seven years this year, that sounds about the right time frame. I started a whole journey of finding myself after that. Anyway, I'm just equal parts blown away by this and glad that I'm not alone. Dog for visibility 😅
